verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents a built-in web interface for managing model installations, plus a gallery (Discover page) for installing models, so the downloaded-models part of the story is covered. There is no evidence of a saved-prompt library or a place to edit per-model configuration. The 'saved message' edit feature applies to chat history, and model aliasing is a related but different feature. missing for 10: saved prompt management, per-model configuration editing in the same UI, any single unified management view covering all three, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage my downloaded models, saved prompts, and per-model configurations in one place

citations.quote: LocalAI comes with a **built-in web interface** for chatting with models, managing installations, configuring AI agents, and more, with no extra tools needed.
Install models from the built-in gallery (Discover page)
local-ai models list          # List available models in the gallery
